# Players

The players UADE ships (its `players/` directory, not counting the `ENV/` config files), and what nuade does with
them. A UADE player counts as ported when a native nuade player plays its modules; each port is A/B tested
against UADE. nuade player ids are the directories in `players/`.

Summary: 137 ported (by 125 nuade players), 8 not ported, 31 skipped on purpose.

## Not ported

Blocked, no module to test with:

- [ ] Paul_Tonge: the replayer is in each module, and none was found in any corpus.

Non-Amiga formats, open:

- [ ] Jochen_Hippel_ST (`hst`, `sdc`). The Atari ST `.soc` modules are refused too; they need their own reference (an
  ST emulator or the original ST replayer).
- [ ] Quartet_ST (`4v`, `qts`)
- [ ] Special-FX_ST (`doda`)
- [ ] Quartet_PSG (`sqt`)
- [ ] YM-2149 (`ym`, `ymst`)
- [ ] MIDI-Loriciel (`midi`)
- [ ] Sierra-AGI (`agi`)
- [ ] ADPCM_mono (`adpcm`)
- [ ] CustomMade `cm` files (the `rk` and `rkb` files of the same player are ported in `ronklaren`)

## Skipped on purpose

Native players exist elsewhere:

- AbyssHighestExperience (AHX)
- ArtOfNoise-4V, ArtOfNoise-8V
- PreTracker
- TFMX, TFMX-7V, TFMX-7V-TFHD, TFMX-Pro, TFMX-Pro-TFHD, TFMX-TFHD, TFMX_ST

libopenmpt plays the format:

- PTK-Prowiz, NoiseTracker, Soundtracker-IV, UltimateSoundtracker (the MOD family)
- MED, Octa-MED, Octa-MED-Ss
- Symphonie (no UADE player; libopenmpt 0.6.9 reads `.symmod`, so it is not ported a second time)
- DIGI-Booster
- ImagesMusicSystem
- ChipTracker
- TCB_Tracker
- MultiMedia_Sound (SoundFX 2.0 / MMS)

MOD packers (unpack, then libopenmpt):

- Alcatraz_Packer, BladePacker, Janne_Salmijarvi_Optimizer, MagneticFieldsPacker, Mosh_Packer, Nick_Pelling_Packer,
  NovoTradePacker, Titanics_Packer
